ooh.d: express admiration and pleasure by uttering `ooh' or `aah'

oomph.d: the activeness of an energetic personality

oort.d: Dutch astronomer who proved that the galaxy is rotating and proposed the existence of the Oort cloud (1900-1992)

oocyte.d: a female gametocyte that develops into an ovum after two meiotic divisions

oolong.d: Chinese tea leaves that have been partially fermented before being dried

oospore.d: a thick-walled sexual spore that develops from a fertilized oosphere in some algae and fungi

ootid.d: mature ovum after penetration by sperm but before the formation of a zygote

oophorectomy.d: surgical removal of one of both ovaries

ooze out.d: release (a liquid) in drops or small quantities

oology.d: the branch of zoology that studies eggs (especially birds' eggs and their size, shape, coloration, and number)
